These are projections of real running configuration files, captured read-only.
The group alias, title and topic are redacted; actor, command, environment,
scope, path and credential fields are omitted. Settings retain only selected
observability scalars. Timestamps and retained scalar values are unchanged.
JSON projections are valid YAML. No historical record is generated.

Tests copy these bytes into temporary files. Equal-length edits, interrupted
writes, replacement, symlinks, padding and removal are explicit filesystem
controls, rather than claims about the captured configuration's history.
